<!--
New features need to be agreed on here before any code is written.
CamillaDSP has a single maintainer, who has to keep every merged feature working for years.
If the expected maintenance burden is large compared to the likely benefit,
a feature will not be added, even when someone offers to write it.
See the Contributing section of the README for more.
-->

**What do you want to do?**
Describe the problem or use case, not only the solution.

**Proposed approach**
How could CamillaDSP support it? Leave this out if you are not sure.

**Who else would use it?**
Is this something many users need, or mostly for your own setup?

**Alternatives**
Can it already be done some other way, for example with existing filters, a separate tool, or a fork?
